<description>
With substitutes disabled, `guix-codesign` can fail when building [oscrypto](https://pypi.org/project/oscrypto/) 1.3.0. The `test_dump_private` test raises `ZeroDivisionError`.

The Guix time-machine bump in bitcoin/bitcoin#36233 (merged after the 32.x branch-off) pulls in OpenSSL 3.5.5, which can finish oscrypto's initial PBKDF2 benchmark in under a millisecond. oscrypto truncates this duration to zero and then divides by it. This was fixed upstream in wbond/oscrypto@144c12195001b08b9ccecb8a3fd041d22ae24474

This PR adds the fix to `contrib/guix/patches`. It can be dropped once a new oscrypto release includes the fix and a Guix time machine bump includes it.
</description>

1.3.0. The test_dump_private test raises ZeroDivisionError.

The Guix time-machine bump in bitcoin/bitcoin#36233 pulls in OpenSSL
3.5.5, which can finish oscrypto's initial PBKDF2 benchmark in under a
millisecond. oscrypto truncates this duration to zero and then divides
by it.

Apply the upstream fix:
wbond/oscrypto@144c12195001b08b9ccecb8a3fd041d22ae24474

diff --git a/contrib/guix/manifest_codesign.scm b/contrib/guix/manifest_codesign.scm
index 4546c18efb..9351f99e98 100644
--- a/contrib/guix/manifest_codesign.scm
+++ b/contrib/guix/manifest_codesign.scm
@@ -3,15 +3,23 @@
              ((gnu packages crypto) #:select (osslsigncode))
              ((gnu packages nss) #:select (nss-certs))
              ((gnu packages python-build) #:select (python-poetry-core python-setuptools))
-             ((gnu packages python-crypto) #:select (python-asn1crypto python-oscrypto))
+             ((gnu packages python-crypto)
+              #:select (python-asn1crypto
+                        (python-oscrypto . guix:python-oscrypto)))
              ((gnu packages tls) #:select (openssl))
              ((gnu packages version-control) #:select (git-minimal))
              (guix build-system python)
              (guix build-system pyproject)
+             (guix gexp)
              (guix git-download)
              ((guix licenses) #:prefix license:)
              (guix packages))
 
+(define-public python-oscrypto
+  ;; Avoid division by zero when PBKDF2 takes less than a millisecond.
+  (package-with-extra-patches guix:python-oscrypto
+    (list (local-file "patches/oscrypto-pbkdf2-timing.patch"))))
+
 (define-public python-elfesteem
   (let ((commit "2eb1e5384ff7a220fd1afacd4a0170acff54fe56"))
     (package
diff --git a/contrib/guix/patches/oscrypto-pbkdf2-timing.patch b/contrib/guix/patches/oscrypto-pbkdf2-timing.patch
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000..9b90bcca6a
--- /dev/null
+++ b/contrib/guix/patches/oscrypto-pbkdf2-timing.patch
@@ -0,0 +1,33 @@
+From 144c12195001b08b9ccecb8a3fd041d22ae24474 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
+From: wbond <will@wbond.net>
+Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 19:28:28 -0400
+Subject: [PATCH] Handle KDF generation on very fast ARM machines
+
+---
+ oscrypto/kdf.py | 6 ++++--
+ 1 file changed, 4 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)
+
+diff --git a/oscrypto/kdf.py b/oscrypto/kdf.py
+index 5db07cd..961f105 100644
+--- a/oscrypto/kdf.py
++++ b/oscrypto/kdf.py
+@@ -50,8 +50,8 @@ def _get_start():
+     def _get_elapsed(start):
+         length = datetime.now() - start
+         seconds = length.seconds + (length.days * 24 * 3600)
+-        milliseconds = (length.microseconds / 10 ** 3)
+-        return int(milliseconds + (seconds * 10 ** 3))
++        milliseconds = length.microseconds / 10 ** 3
++        return milliseconds + (seconds * 10 ** 3)
+ 
+ 
+ def pbkdf2_iteration_calculator(hash_algorithm, key_length, target_ms=100, quiet=False):
+@@ -135,6 +135,8 @@ def _measure():
+         start = _get_start()
+         pbkdf2(hash_algorithm, password, salt, iterations, key_length)
+         observed_ms = _get_elapsed(start)
++        if observed_ms < 1:
++            observed_ms = 1
+         if not quiet:
+             print('%s iterations in %sms' % (iterations, observed_ms))
+         return 1.0 / target_ms * observed_ms

</patch>
